mechanism: Estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing chlorpromazine metabolism via conjugation and CYP pathways, while chlorpromazine may increase estradiol levels through hepatic enzyme modulation; additive CNS depression also occurs.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, extrapyramidal symptoms) and consider dose adjustment; assess estrogen-related side effects; counsel on CNS depression risk.
